effects: Pulls `amount` tBTC (the vault's collateral 0x18084f…, set at init) from the signer to the vault with safeTransferFrom, using the signer's existing allowance.
Credits active vault shares, worked out from the vault's stake/share ratio, to `onBehalfOf`. This can be another address, which then owns the deposit.
Reverts if the deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or if the deposit limit would be exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 tBTC for the beneficiary address, with the vault, the amount in tBTC and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown; the vault works it out from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor shows only #.amount and #.onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None possible: the value is not in the calldata.

effects: Burns active shares from the signer's position, enough (rounded up) to cover `amount` tBTC. The share count comes from storage.
Moves `amount` tBTC of stake into the withdrawal queue of the next epoch, credited to `claimer` as withdrawal shares. No tokens move in this call.
`claimer` (it can be another address) gets the right to claim that tBTC once the next epoch has ended. Until then it can still be slashed.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 tBTC withdrawal for the claim owner, with the vault, the requested assets in tBTC and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of active shares burned from the signer is not shown; it comes from storage with rounding up.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` then _withdraw: `_activeSharesOf[msg.sender].push(..., activeSharesOf(msg.sender) - burnedShares)`.
findings.fix: None possible: the value is not in the calldata. The tBTC amount shown is the asset value that leaves the position.

effects: Burns exactly `shares` active shares from the signer's position.
Moves the tBTC value of those shares (rounded down, from storage) into the next epoch's withdrawal queue, credited to `claimer`. No tokens move in this call.
`claimer` (it can be another address) gets the right to claim that tBTC after the next epoch.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim owner, with the vault, the raw share count and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the shares are shown as a raw integer and the tBTC value queued is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());`. The Vault ABI has no decimals or symbol (V1 shares are not an ERC-20). Descriptor: `#.shares` 'Vault shares (raw)' format raw.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: no share token exists to format with, and the asset value comes from storage. The '(raw)' label is the honest choice.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed, which uses up the signer's claim right for that epoch.
Sends tBTC equal to withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) from the vault to `recipient`, which can be someone other than the signer. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient, with the vault, the epoch number and the recipient as fields. No token or amount is named.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says the claimed asset is tBTC; intent and fields name only an epoch.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` with collateral = tBTC. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim tBTC withdrawal', with interpolatedIntent 'Claim tBTC from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the tBTC amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.fix: None possible: the amount is not in the calldata.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for each listed epoch as claimed, which uses up those claim rights.
Sends the sum of the signer's tBTC withdrawals for those epochs from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient, with the vault, each epoch and the recipient as fields. No token or amount is named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says the claimed asset is tBTC; only epoch numbers and a recipient appear.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Name the asset, for example intent 'Claim tBTC withdrawals' and 'Claim tBTC from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total tBTC sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);` where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
findings.fix: None possible: the amount is not in the calldata.
